department: Department of Municipal Administration & Urban Development
desc_en: Apply for an official birth certificate for births registered within municipal corporation limits.
desc_hi: नगर निगम सीमा के भीतर पंजीकृत जन्मों के लिए आधिकारिक जन्म प्रमाण पत्र हेतु आवेदन करें।
desc_te: మున్సిపల్ కార్పొరేషన్ పరిధిలో నమోదైన జననాల కోసం అధికారిక జనన ధృవీకరణ పత్రం కొరకు దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోండి.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of children born within municipal limits; registration within 21 days is free.
steps_json: Submit online application or visit citizen service center
Upload hospital verification slip and parental ID copies
Verification by Registrar of Births and Deaths
Download digitally signed certificate or collect hard copy
fees: Free within 21 days; Rs. 30 late fee up to 1 year; Rs. 50 with Magistrate order after 1 year

department: Municipal Water Supply and Sewerage Board
desc_en: Request a metered piped drinking water connection for residential buildings and apartments.
desc_hi: आवासीय भवनों और अपार्टमेंटों के लिए मीटरयुक्त पाइपयुक्त पेयजल कनेक्शन का अनुरोध करें।
desc_te: నివాస గృహాలు మరియు అపార్ట్‌మెంట్ల కొరకు పైపుల ద్వారా మీటర్డ్ తాగునీటి కనెక్షన్ దరఖాస్తు.
eligibility: Property owners or authorized tenants with property tax receipts within piped network coverage area.
documents_json: Neighbour Water Consumer No (for pipeline reference)
steps_json: Submit application with municipal property index number
Technical site inspection by junior engineer within 5 days
Pay connection estimate and meter security charges
Road cutting permission and pipeline tapping execution
Meter installation and water supply commencement
fees: Application fee Rs. 250; Connection estimate based on pipe size and distance

desc_en: Application for low-tension single-phase or three-phase domestic electric power supply and smart meter.
desc_hi: लो-टेंशन सिंगल-फेज या थ्री-फेज घरेलू बिजली आपूर्ति और स्मार्ट मीटर हेतु आवेदन।
desc_te: సింగిల్ ఫేజ్ లేదా త్రీ ఫేజ్ గృహ విద్యుత్ సరఫరా మరియు స్మార్ట్ మీటర్ కొరకు దరఖాస్తు.
eligibility: Owner or lawful occupant of residential premises with internal wiring completion test report.
documents_json: Ownership proof (Sale Deed / Partition Deed / Gift Deed)
Licensed Electrical Contractor Wiring Completion Certificate
steps_json: Submit LT power connection form online
Verification of premises and load feasibility by Section Officer
Issuance of Demand Notice for Development and Security Charges
Payment confirmation and meter dispatch to field squad
Service line erection, meter installation and power energisation
fees: Security deposit Rs. 1,200 (1 kW single-phase); service connection charges Rs. 500
processing_time: 7 working days where no network extension is needed

desc_en: Renew expired non-transport (private) or transport commercial driving licences online.
desc_hi: समाप्त हो चुके गैर-परिवहन (निजी) या परिवहन वाणिज्यिक ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस को ऑनलाइन नवीनीकृत करें।
desc_te: గడువు ముగిసిన ప్రైవేట్ లేదా రవాణా కమర్షియల్ డ్రైవింగ్ లైసెన్స్ ఆన్‌లైన్ పునరుద్ధరణ.
eligibility: Holders of valid or expired Indian driving licence (within grace period or up to 1 year for standard renewal).
documents_json: Form 1 Self-Declaration or Form 1A Medical Certificate (for age 40+)
steps_json: Enter driving licence number and date of birth on transport portal
Fill renewal details and upload medical fitness certificate if aged 40+
Pay renewal fee and biometric verification charge
Book slot for biometric capture if photo/signature refresh required
Smart card driving licence dispatched by speed post
fees: Rs. 200 standard renewal + Rs. 200 smart card fee; Rs. 300 additional late fee per year of delay

desc_en: Government certificate certifying annual household income for education scholarships and welfare subsidies.
desc_hi: शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति और कल्याणकारी योजनाओं हेतु वार्षिक पारिवारिक आय प्रमाणित करने वाला सरकारी प्रमाण पत्र।
desc_te: విద్యా స్కాలర్‌షిప్‌లు మరియు సంక్షేమ పథకాల కోసం వార్షిక కుటుంబ ఆదాయ ధృవీకరణ పత్రం.
eligibility: Resident citizens whose family income is assessed by local revenue village officer / tahsildar.
documents_json: Salary Slips / Form 16 / ITR or Village Administrative Officer Income Enquiry Report
Ration Card or Family Head declaration
steps_json: Apply via citizen portal with family details and financial year
Field enquiry and verification by Village Revenue Officer (VRO)
Review and recommendation by Revenue Inspector (RI)
Digital signature and approval by Tahsildar / Deputy Tahsildar
Download digitally verifiable certificate with QR code
fees: Rs. 45 user charge at digital citizen counters

desc_en: Lodge an online lost report for missing documents (PAN, Passport, Cheque books, Certificates) or mobile phones without visiting a police station.
desc_hi: थाने जाए बिना गुम हुए दस्तावेजों (पैन, पासपोर्ट, चेक बुक, प्रमाण पत्र) या मोबाइल फोन के लिए ऑनलाइन गुमशुदगी रिपोर्ट दर्ज करें।
desc_te: పోలీస్ స్టేషన్‌కు వెళ్లకుండా పోయిన పత్రాలు (పాన్, పాస్‌పోర్ట్, చెక్ బుక్, సర్టిఫికెట్లు) లేదా మొబైల్ కొరకు ఆన్‌లైన్ మిస్సింగ్ రిపోర్ట్ నమోదు.
eligibility: Any individual who has lost personal articles or documents within jurisdiction where no cognizable crime or violence is alleged.
documents_json: Serial numbers / document numbers of missing items (e.g., IMEI for phone, certificate roll no)
steps_json: Submit complainant details, incident location, and item details online
Verify mobile number via one-time SMS verification
System generates digitally signed Lost Report acknowledgement PDF instantly
Use acknowledgement to apply for duplicate documents at issuing authorities
fees: Completely free of charge

department: Department of Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies
desc_en: Add newborn babies or newlywed spouses to an existing food security ration card database.
desc_hi: मौजूदा खाद्य सुरक्षा राशन कार्ड में नवजात शिशुओं या नवविवाहित जीवनसाथी का नाम जोड़ें।
desc_te: ప్రస్తుత ఆహార భద్రతా రేషన్ కార్డులో నవజాత శిశువులు లేదా కొత్తగా పెళ్లయిన జీవిత భాగస్వామి పేరు నమోదు.
eligibility: Existing active ration cardholder families with proof of relationship.
documents_json: Birth certificate (for child) OR Marriage certificate & Deletion certificate from previous card (for spouse)
Aadhaar Card of newly added member
steps_json: Fill member addition request form on civil supplies portal
Upload supporting relationship documents and biometrics consent
Verification by Civil Supplies Inspector / Mandal Revenue Office
Card database updated and revised e-Ration card available for print
fees: Rs. 20 citizen service fee

department: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development
desc_en: Monthly financial pension assistance disbursed to elderly destitute citizens from low-income households.
desc_hi: कम आय वाले परिवारों के निराश्रित बुजुर्ग नागरिकों को दिया जाने वाला मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहयोग।
desc_te: తక్కువ ఆదాయం కలిగిన నిరుపేద వృద్ధులకు ప్రతి నెలా అందించే ఆర్థిక పింఛను సహాయం.
eligibility: Citizens aged 60 years or above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families without steady alternative financial support.
documents_json: Proof of Age (Birth Certificate / School Leaving / Voter ID)
Bank Account Passbook seeded with Aadhaar
steps_json: Submit pension application at local ward secretarial office or portal
Physical verification of age and living condition by social welfare worker
Sanction order approved by District Collector / Social Welfare Officer
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) credit to bank account every month
fees: Free service

desc_en: Transfer of property ownership records in municipal tax registers following sale, inheritance, gift, or court decree.
desc_hi: बिक्री, विरासत, उपहार या अदालती डिक्री के बाद नगरपालिका कर रजिस्टरों में संपत्ति स्वामित्व का नामांतरण।
desc_te: క్రయవిక్రయం, వారసత్వం లేదా గిఫ్ట్ డీడ్ తర్వాత మున్సిపల్ పన్ను రికార్డులలో ఆస్తి యాజమాన్య హక్కుల బదిలీ.
eligibility: New owner or legal successor of land or building situated within municipal bounds.
documents_json: Registered Sale Deed / Gift Deed / Will & Death Certificate
steps_json: Submit mutation application on municipal web portal
Payment of mutation fee (percentage of registered property value)
Public notice issuance (15-day objection period)
Scrutiny by municipal revenue inspector and verification of site
Issuance of new Property Assessment Book and mutated tax demand
fees: 0.1% of registered value or minimum Rs. 500

department: Health and Sanitation Wing, Municipal Corporation
desc_en: Statutory permission for operating commercial shops, hotels, factories, and clinics within urban local boundaries.
desc_hi: शहरी स्थानीय सीमाओं के भीतर वाणिज्यिक दुकानों, होटलों, कारखानों और क्लीनिकों के संचालन हेतु वैधानिक अनुमति।
desc_te: పట్టణ పరిధిలో దుకాణాలు, హోటళ్ళు, కర్మాగారాలు నిర్వహించడానికి చట్టబద్ధమైన ట్రేడ్ లైసెన్స్ అనుమతి.
eligibility: Business proprietors, partnership firms, or corporate entities occupying commercial premises.
documents_json: Lease / Rental Agreement or Property Tax Receipt of Shop
Fire Safety NOC (for hazardous trades / restaurants)
steps_json: Select trade category and enter business square footage
Upload premises rental deed and fire clearance if applicable
Inspection by municipal sanitary inspector within 7 days
Online fee payment as per municipal schedule of rates
Download QR-coded Trade Licence certificate
fees: Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 15,000 based on area and nature of trade

desc_en: Report non-functional streetlights, blinking LED fixtures, or broken poles in public residential lanes.
desc_hi: सार्वजनिक आवासीय गलियों में खराब स्ट्रीट लाइट, टिमटिमाती एलईडी या टूटे खंभों की मरम्मत की सूचना दें।
desc_te: వీధుల్లో వెలగని లైట్లు, మినుకుమినుకుమనే ఎల్ఈడీ బల్బులు లేదా విరిగిన స్తంభాల మరమ్మత్తు సమాచారం.
eligibility: Any citizen or neighborhood association reporting public streetlight issues.
steps_json: File complaint with ward number and nearest pole number
Automated assignment to designated area electrical junior engineer
Field lineman inspection and component replacement
Closing notification sent with repair photo confirmation
fees: Zero fee (Free municipal service)

name_hi: भूमिगत सीवरेज चोक एवं जल निकासी सफाई
name_te: భూగర్భ మురుగు కాలువల పూడికతీత మరియు క్లియరెన్స్
desc_en: Request high-velocity jetting machines or suction tankers to clear choked underground sewer lines and overflowing manholes.
desc_hi: चोक भूमिगत सीवर लाइनों और उफनते मैनहोलों को साफ करने के लिए जेटिंग मशीनों या सक्शन टैंकरों का अनुरोध करें।
desc_te: పూడుకుపోయిన అండర్‌గ్రౌండ్ మురుగు లైన్లు మరియు పొంగిపొర్లుతున్న మ్యాన్‌హోల్స్ క్లియర్ చేయడానికి జెట్టింగ్ మిషన్ల అభ్యర్థన.
eligibility: Residents or commercial establishments facing municipal drainage overflow.
documents_json: No documents required; ward name and nearby landmark needed
steps_json: Log emergency sewer distress ticket with ward address
Sewerage subdivision supervisor dispatches suction jetting vehicle
Mechanical clearance of manhole and clearing of obstruction
Disinfection spraying and complaint resolution
fees: Free of charge for public street lines

department: Directorate of Public Health & Family Welfare
name_hi: मातृ एवं शिशु स्वास्थ्य टीकाकरण पंजीकरण
name_te: తల్లి మరియు శిశు ఆరోగ్య టీకా నమోదు
desc_en: Register pregnant women and infants for complete universal immunization schedule and nutritional tracking.
desc_hi: पूर्ण सार्वभौमिक टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम और पोषण संबंधी निगरानी के लिए गर्भवती महिलाओं और शिशुओं का पंजीकरण।
desc_te: సమగ్ర రోగనిరోధక టీకాల షెడ్యూల్ మరియు పౌష్టికాహార పర్యవేక్షణ కొరకు గర్భిణులు, శిశువుల నమోదు.
eligibility: Expectant mothers and all infants residing within the health sub-center or primary health center jurisdiction.
steps_json: Visit primary health center (PHC) or register with accredited social health activist (ASHA)
Entry into reproductive and child health tracking database
Issuance of MCP (Mother-Child Protection) physical handbook and digital RCH ID
Automated SMS alerts for upcoming vaccination dates (BCG, Polio, Pentavalent, Measles)
fees: Completely free of charge including all vaccines and iron-folic acid supplements
processing_time: Same-day issuance at Primary Health Center

name_en: RTE 25% Free Quota Private School Admission
desc_en: Admission under Right to Education (RTE) Act Section 12(1)(c) for children from disadvantaged groups in private unaided schools.
desc_hi: निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों में वंचित और कमजोर वर्ग के बच्चों के लिए शिक्षा का अधिकार (आरटीई) अधिनियम के तहत प्रवेश।
desc_te: నిరుపేద, వెనుకబడిన వర్గాల పిల్లలకు ప్రైవేట్ పాఠశాలల్లో 25 శాతం ఉచిత సీట్ల కొరకు విద్యా హక్కు చట్టం దరఖాస్తు.
eligibility: Children entering Class 1 or Pre-Primary whose family income is below Rs. 1.5 Lakhs or belonging to SC/ST/disadvantaged categories.
documents_json: Parent Residential Address proof within 1-3 km of school
steps_json: Register on State RTE admissions web portal during annual admission window
Select up to 5 neighborhood private unaided schools
Verification of submitted documents by District Education Officer
Randomized computer lottery for seat allotment
Report to allotted school for fee-exempt enrollment
fees: Free application; 100% tuition fee covered by government
processing_time: Annual admission schedule (lottery results declared within 15 days of closing)

name_en: Senior Citizen Bus Travel Concession Pass
name_hi: वरिष्ठ नागरिक बस यात्रा रियायत पास
name_te: సీనియర్ సిటిజన్ బస్సు ప్రయాణ రాయితీ పాస్
desc_en: Concessional bus travel smart card granting 25% to 50% discount on suburban and rural bus transport.
desc_hi: उपनगरीय और ग्रामीण बस परिवहन पर 25% से 50% की छूट प्रदान करने वाला रियायती स्मार्ट कार्ड।
desc_te: నగర మరియు పల్లె వెలుగు బస్సులలో 25% నుండి 50% రాయితీ పొందేందుకు సీనియర్ సిటిజన్ స్మార్ట్ పాస్.
eligibility: Citizens aged 60 years and above residing within the transport operational territory.
documents_json: Proof of Date of Birth (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
steps_json: Fill RTC bus pass concession form online or at major depot counters
Present original age proof for physical verification
Pay smart card manufacturing fee
Collect laminated smart card or save digital pass on smartphone
fees: Rs. 100 for 1-year laminated RFID smart pass
processing_time: Instant across RTC counter or 3 days online

department: Department of Municipal Administration & Urban Development
desc_en: Official registration and certificate of death occurring within urban corporation limits.
desc_hi: शहरी निगम सीमा के भीतर हुई मृत्यु का आधिकारिक पंजीकरण और प्रमाण पत्र।
desc_te: మున్సిపల్ కార్పొరేషన్ పరిధిలో జరిగిన మరణాల అధికారిక నమోదు మరియు సర్టిఫికెట్ జారీ.
eligibility: Immediate family members, hospital representatives, or legal heirs.
documents_json: Hospital Death Summary / Form 2 from Medical Officer
steps_json: Submit Form 2 along with cremation receipt to Municipal Health Officer
Verification against burial ground register records
Entry into Civil Registration System (CRS)
Download digitally verifiable certificate with security QR code
fees: Free if registered within 21 days; nominal search fee of Rs. 30 thereafter

desc_en: Official certification of social category (SC, ST, BC, OBC) for educational quotas and statutory reservations.
desc_hi: शैक्षिक कोटा और वैधानिक आरक्षण के लिए सामाजिक श्रेणी (एससी, एसटी, बीसी, ओबीसी) का आधिकारिक प्रमाणीकरण।
desc_te: విద్యా ప్రవేశాలు, ఉద్యోగ రిజర్వేషన్ల ప్రయోజనాల కోసం అధికారిక కుల ధృవీకరణ పత్రం.
eligibility: Citizens belonging to notified communities with historical lineage within the state.
documents_json: Father / Mother / Sibling Caste Certificate copy
steps_json: Apply via digital citizen portal with ancestral revenue details
Field inquiry conducted by Village Revenue Officer
Report submitted to Revenue Inspector and Mandal Tehsildar
Approval and digital signing of barcoded caste certificate
fees: Rs. 45 processing fee at citizen service centers

department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
desc_en: Monthly financial subsistence grant for persons with certified permanent physical or intellectual disabilities.
desc_hi: प्रमाणित स्थायी शारीरिक या बौद्धिक दिव्यांगता वाले व्यक्तियों के लिए मासिक वित्तीय अनुदान।
desc_te: శాశ్వత శారీరక లేదా మానసిక వైకల్యం కలిగిన వారికి ప్రభుత్వం అందించే నెలవారీ ఆర్థిక భరోసా.
eligibility: Persons having 40% or higher disability as certified by a recognized Medical Board.
documents_json: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card or District Medical Board Certificate
Bank Account Details linked with Aadhaar
steps_json: Register on social welfare portal with UDID number
Validation of medical board percentage against national UDID registry
Approval by District Welfare Officer
Monthly pension credit directly to applicant's Aadhaar-enabled bank account
fees: Zero fee (Free public welfare benefit)

department: Town Planning Section, Urban Development Authority
desc_en: Online building permission and sanction for constructing or modifying residential houses up to 3 floors.
desc_hi: 3 मंजिलों तक के आवासीय मकानों के निर्माण या संशोधन हेतु ऑनलाइन भवन निर्माण अनुमति।
desc_te: మూడు అంతస్తుల వరకు ఇళ్ల నిర్మాణం లేదా పునరుద్ధరణ కొరకు ఆన్‌లైన్ భవన నిర్మాణ ప్రణాళిక అనుమతి.
eligibility: Plot owners possessing registered clear-title plot deeds located in approved layouts.
documents_json: CAD Drawing Building Plan signed by licensed architect
steps_json: Upload AutoCAD architectural plan to auto-scrutiny building portal
Automated building by-law validation (setbacks, height, FAR)
Site inspection by municipal town planning officer
Pay building permit fee and development charges online
Instant download of approved sanction drawing and permit order
fees: Calculated by built-up square area (approx Rs. 50 to Rs. 150 per sq. meter)

desc_en: Subsidized or free 7-to-9 hour daytime agricultural power supply for farmers operating irrigation borewells.
